titulo: The same task in the three eras, and your plan
lead: The best proof that the way of working has changed is to do the same task three times: with just the prompt, with prompt and context, and with the full role. You see with your own eyes what each era delivers. Then you build the plan with dates to put your first agent to work, one step at a time.
objetivo: compare the same task done in all three eras and walk away with a dated plan for your first agent.

nos.detalhe: You write the request in a temporary chat (no memory), outside the project: no saved rules, no example, no measure. It's the starting point: it shows what the AI does on its own.
The same request, now inside the project with the base from lesson 3. The tone and the company rules arrive before the request.
The sheet from lesson 4, the goal from lesson 5 and the procedure from lesson 6. The agent checks itself against the Measure and hands in the proof along with the work.

rolagem_fim.texto: Version 1 shows what the AI does on its own. Version 2 shows what context adds. Version 3 shows what managing adds: a goal, an example and training.

degraus.passo: Reinforces the role sheet's Measure: three requests rewritten and the agent showing the check.
Requires the role sheet with a Measure. Five rounds, the list, and the cycle until it hits zero; the cycle can take two days.

resultado.titulo: At the end of the course
resultado.texto: An agent with a role, a measurable goal, a trained procedure, and a tracked cost.

rolagem_fim.texto: Context, role sheet, measure, training, and cost, in that order. Only move up when the "done when" of the previous step is true.

secoes.legenda: Each step builds on what the previous one set up.

secoes.sub: Pick a start date and how much time you have each week. The plan respects the exercises that need days of real use.

txt.travou: ## What got stuck and the rule I created

itens.t: Stop hunting for the perfect prompt
itens.texto: Define the role: a goal you can measure, context, and an example of your own.
Several rounds, a list of corrections and a written procedure. The same mistake doesn't come back.
The right model, cache, batching and a bill you keep an eye on. There are no miracles: you can only relax once the system runs right.

secoes.sub: Four questions about the whole course.

perguntas.p: When you compare the three versions, what is the yardstick?
opcoes: The length of the text in each version.
How long the AI took to answer in each version.
The Measure from the role sheet, the same for all three.
perguntas.explica: A single yardstick keeps the comparison fair. The Measure from the sheet tells you whether the result is good enough, in any version.

perguntas.p: What is the order of the steps in the plan?
opcoes: Any order, because the steps are independent.
perguntas.explica: The sheet points to the context base; the measure pins down the sheet's goal; the training uses the Measure; the cost test uses the trained procedure.

perguntas.p: What does role engineering change in your work?
opcoes: You stop checking what the AI does.
You start defining the role, checking and correcting, as you would with someone on your team.
You need to learn to code.
perguntas.explica: The role is management: sheet, measure, example, training and cost. Checking still happens, only now from time to time and with a yardstick.

perguntas.p: The agent made the same mistake twice. What was missing?
opcoes: Turning the first correction into a written rule (a lesson or a procedure).
Explaining the correction again in the same conversation, in more detail.
Opening a new conversation so it starts from scratch.
perguntas.explica: A correction that stays only in the chat disappears. Written into the lesson or the procedure, it goes into every task that follows.
